The error-button proposal is clear, so I rewrote nothing. `node Server/text-check.mjs` returned no flags for its folder. I did not shoot any pages, since the folder has no `page.js` and this is a proposal.

The `requirements.md` title and ask say what the problem is: a stale dictate button on the "Page Load Error" screen. The steps are short and numbered. I appended one "clear" line to `.claude/skills/clarity/flags.jsonl`.
